completedBarRule.base: the first completed close NOT known at the state evaluation time (i.e. first bar with completedAt >= evalTime); for a normal 18:00 UTC state this is the same-day close
completedBarRule.completedAt: scheduled close + 60 min (adopted from PR #61 v2 design; PR #61 is OPEN and not part of 1cfa129, so the rule is enforced by the evaluation harness, not by prod code)
completedBarRule.knownAtState: a bar is usable as an input iff completedAt < state evaluation time
completedBarRule.sessionClose: scheduled XNYS close (16:00 ET; 13:00 ET on early-close days)

definitions.downsideEvent: E_h = 1 if MDD_h <= -0.10 (a drawdown of 10% or more within the horizon, measured on ^SP500TR closes from the base); secondary threshold -0.20 for h>=63
definitions.forwardReturn: R_h = P[b+h]/P[b] - 1, b = base session index, P = ^SP500TR close
definitions.maxDrawdown: MDD_h = min_{k=0..h} (P[b+k]/max_{j=0..k} P[b+j] - 1); close-to-close, includes base; reported as a negative fraction
definitions.realizedVol: RV_h = sqrt(252) * sd(ln(P[b+k]/P[b+k-1]), k=1..h, ddof=1); defined for h>=5 only (h=1 omitted)
definitions.regimeTransition: T_h = 1 if the frozen PI regime band at the designated state h sessions later differs from the band at the state; U_h = 1 if it is higher. Computable only where the PI path is reconstructed (C1) or recorded (C2); reported per horizon as frequency with CI. Exploratory.

eventList.primaryForH4: ruleB onset10 dates; bear = onset20 present
eventList.ruleA: all-time-high drawdown episodes on ^GSPC: onset10 = first close >= 10% below running max; ends at a new running max
eventList.ruleB: rolling 252-session-high drawdown episodes on ^GSPC: onset10 = first close >= 10% below max of the last 252 closes; ends when drawdown recovers above -2%

horizonNotes: Horizons count XNYS trading sessions after the base close, never calendar days. Horizons 126 and 252 are descriptive in set C1 (N_eff < 30 by construction).

missingData.earlyCloseDays: complete sessions with 13:00 ET close; completedAt 14:00 ET.
missingData.incompleteTradingDay: a bar whose completedAt is after the time of use is treated as non-existent for that use (never used as base, target or input).
missingData.marketHolidaysAndUnscheduledClosures: not sessions (e.g. 2012-10-29/30, 2018-12-05, 2025-01-09); no state, no bar, horizons skip them.
missingData.missingBaseOrTargetBar: outcome is DEFERRED; it is never shifted to an adjacent bar. Re-fetch daily for 10 sessions; then status MISSING_BAR with reason; excluded and counted.
missingData.notYetMatured: PENDING; excluded from that horizon only.
